messages:
Rajan Singh: Heads up — after the RBAC refactor this morning some users report 403 on deploy endpoints even though audit shows role assigned.

Amelia Chen: Which users? can you paste a sample event id?

Rajan Singh: laura.m and infra-ci (service account). Example event:
```
{"ts":"1834567801","event":"rbac.assign","actor":"svc:orchestrator","target":"user:laura.m","role":"deployer","event_id":"evt_01F8A1B"}
```
But Laura still gets `403` and console shows role missing in user cache.

Devin Patel: Hmm. Could be propagation job failed. Did we change role IDs in the refactor? IIRC we migrated to canonical_role_id and left old id mapping in store.

Amelia Chen: Good call. I just queried the audit store for that event_id and see the actor field present, but the storage metadata blob for the role change is in s3://redwood-audits/2026/03/18/part-0001.avro — size 0 for that partition.

Claire Gomez: :eyes: ops-bot showed a partial write at 2026-03-18T09:45Z — maybe a producer timeout. ops-bot: "WARN producer: failed to flush partition 12"

security-bot: ORPHANED_EVENT detected evt_01F8A1B -> missing downstream mutation in auth-service (replay_needed)

Devin Patel: Also check KMS decrypt logs — if the metadata blob failed to decrypt downstream, the auth-service might have skipped applying the change. Which KMS key is used for audit blobs now?

Amelia Chen: We switched to projects/redwood/kms/audit-key during refactor. I'll check Cloud KMS logs and re-run the decrypt on that object.

Rajan Singh: Repro steps I ran: run `authctl refresh-cache --user laura.m` then watch `/auth/cache/registry` — the role entry isn't present.

Amelia Chen: Action items: 1) I'll attempt S3 object re-decrypt + replay (will post results). 2) Devin — grep KMS audit logs for failed_decrypt with key audit-key. 3) Claire — can you check producer retries and partition 12 retention? If we confirm partial write, we'll run replay pipeline.

Devin Patel: On it. If we find decrypt failures, we should add a metric and an alert (decrypt_failure_count) so this doesn't go unnoticed.

Claire Gomez: Created a short incident note in #incidents if we need escalation. inc-2026-03-18-rbac-orphaning

Rajan Singh: Thanks. tagging @sec-eng for visibility :sec_alert: 

Amelia Chen: Quick query I'll run:
```
SELECT event_id, status, decrypted FROM audits WHERE event_id='evt_01F8A1B';
```
Will paste output.

security-bot: audit-replay queued evt_01F8A1B -> task_id: replay-20260318-7

Amelia Chen: replay succeeded — auth-service applied mutation, laura.m can access deploys again. Will follow up with a postmortem and change to ensure producer flush on critical RBAC partitions.

Rajan Singh: Nice. Let's also add a post-deploy check in the refactor pipeline to diff role assignments for a small sample of users.

Claire Gomez: noted. closing thread when PM is ok with postmortem.
